summary: Retain managed VM OS identity on Core and label historical guest information

guide.reason: Explain last-detected OS, configured fallback, QEMU Guest Agent recovery and mixed-version limits.

api.reason: Add bounded DetectedOS records to peer and master inventory and client VM responses, gated by the detected-os-v1 Controller acknowledgement. Existing authentication and host ownership rules apply.

roadmap.reason: Corrects OS display persistence without changing phase status or expanding VM power workflows.

state.reason: Historical OS is pool resource information; Controller adds no private durable state.
state.record: The pool master's pool-vms.json vms[VM ID].detected_os record, included in authority replication and adoption. Assigned hosts retain local_detected_os in their pool-vms.json for retry through master outages. A fresh Controller recovers the master's authenticated managed.detected_os inventory and exposes it on the existing VM API.

verification.method: Executed focused Go persistence, mTLS peer publication/retry, fresh Controller adoption and capability checks; UI regression failed before and passed after, followed by UI suite/typecheck/build and simulated browser review. The QA report records final check results and unverified live-guest limits.
